correctness.rationale: Derived F_d(z)=(r^d+r^(m-d))/(1+r^m) by absorbing-interval recurrence with z=2r/(1+r^2), and M=(1-F)/(qF). Factoring mean difference H=(1-r)^2P yields reciprocal polynomial deg m-2 with P(0)=1 and P(1)=-d(m-d)kappa/6. Explicit midpoint coefficients change sign at most once so Descartes and reciprocity limit positive roots to two; plus endpoint multiplicity proves a unique crossing iff kappa>0 and none otherwise, including kappa=0. The normalized ratio is a secant slope of f(v)=sech(theta sqrt(v)), strictly convex because it is a Brownian exit-time Laplace transform, establishing strict distance nesting. Independent rational absorbing-chain matrices and coefficient signs checked m<=70.
